FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 235
Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 235 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of attorney fees, court costs, and civil
penalties, up to $50,000 per violation, collected by the Attorney General pursuant to this bill.
